Trump to sign EO to end Operation Checkpoint 2.0. SEC looking to ease crypto firm registration rules. Senate committee to vote on stablecoin bill. Mt Gox makes second $900m+ move in a week. Coinbase to launch 24/7 perp-style futures in US. Coinbase gets license in India. Deutsche Borse to offer BTC, ETH custody services. SGP exchange rolls out open-ended BTC futures. ETH’s Pectra upgrade on Sepolia disrupted. Lazarus have laundered $300m from ByBit hack. Thai SEC approves USDT. Offchain labs to add ARB tokens to treasury. Next coins to pump will be ‘completely different’.
